ValidationRule.description: 當Transportation = Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family (driver’s information required) 親友接送(需提供司機資訊) ，【Driver Info】【Driver's Phone】為必填
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL(Transportation__c, "Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family (driver’s information required)"), ISPICKVAL( Private_Terminal_Type__c , "LAPS"), OR( ISBLANK(Driver_Info__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_Phone__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When the Transportation = Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family (driver’s information required),【Driver Info】【Driver's Phone】can't be empty.
